source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Wistron-BIOS-00006-V003 occurs in two workbook rows; this AFUEFI-reflash variant is bound to Functionality row 339 and its hash.

source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Flash System ROM to the same version with AMI flash tool for uEFI.
1. Send command: afuefix64.efi <BIOS filename> /P /B /N /ME
2. Reboot the system
3. Check version in BIOS setup menu and OS

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. BIOS should be flashed without errors
2. Version should be shown correctly in BIOS and OS

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Reads an SMBIOS header only; omits the reflash.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES but substitutes a read-only SMBIOS header for the destructive same-version reflash.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; restores AFUEFI write, same-version support, write proof and recovery.

original_test_intent: Perform a supported same-version System ROM reflash with AFUEFI, prove the write actually completed, reboot, and verify the unchanged approved version in BIOS Setup and OS without flash errors.
original_method: Validate exact same-version image/tool and vendor reflash support, board identity and region flags, capture baseline configuration and recovery readiness, execute the uninterrupted write, retain AFU completion evidence distinct from version equality, then verify BIOS Setup/OS health.
manual_activity: An engineer must supervise EFI-shell flash completion and confirm the BIOS Setup version/settings. The agent can stage artifacts, capture write and OS/BMC evidence, and analyze screenshots, but cannot replace the source's required visual BIOS-menu acceptance.
required_inputs: Exact board identity and current BIOS/ME/security/settings baseline
Same-version signed/checksummed image and vendor reflash support/reason
Approved AFUEFI build and `/P /B /N /ME` region policy
Bootable EFI access, stable AC and maintenance window
Recovery image/procedure and independent BMC/OOB path
safety_requirements: Do not reduce this to dmidecode; same-version equality does not prove a reflash occurred.
Validate every region flag and same-version support before writing.
Never interrupt power or reboot during the write; stop and preserve the first AFU error.
No automatic retry, alternate image/flags, blind power-cycle or recovery flash.
agent_execution_scope: Validate identities, hashes, vendor support, flags, power and recovery readiness.
Stage exact artifacts and capture complete AFUEFI, reboot, OS/BMC and BIOS-screen evidence under engineer supervision.
Separate write-completion evidence from version evidence and prepare Tool Result.
engineer_actions: Approve reason and supervise the destructive same-version reflash.
Observe BIOS Setup version/settings and confirm acceptance.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No fit: `dmidecode -t 0 | grep SMBIOS` reports the SMBIOS specification header rather than BIOS firmware version and cannot prove a write.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the source AFUEFI command with approved image/flags; use a correct OS BIOS-version field only as additive post-check evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Same-version reflash, exact command/flags, reboot, BIOS/OS verification, script and 5/20-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: SOURCE REFLASH RETAINED WITH WRITE-PROOF AND HUMAN SETUP CHECK
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the current and target identical version to the same approved image hash, capture AFU erase/program/verify completion and reboot state, then pair correct OS version fields with human-observed BIOS Setup/settings.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only platforms whose vendor supports same-version AFUEFI reflash with the selected regions.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record AFUEFI/image hashes, board revision, BIOS/ME versions, BMC and EFI environment.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform/AMI same-version reflash procedure and referenced project script.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit write proof, vendor support and configuration-preservation controls without changing reflash semantics.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Vendor same-version reflash and recovery policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Post-reboot version equality alone is expected even if no write occurred; raw AFU completion evidence is essential.

project_override_considerations: Projects may approve different region coverage or evidence fields, but must prove an actual same-version write and disclose regions omitted.
expected_evidence: Board/current state, same-version image hash, AFUEFI hash, vendor support and region approval
Exact command and full erase/program/verify output/status under stable power
Controlled reboot and OS/BMC platform-health/configuration evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requires same-version reflash and dual-location verification. DeepSeek's unrelated SMBIOS read is a historical-review defect.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation is clear; vendor support/artifacts are readiness inputs, while required human BIOS-menu acceptance is represented by MANUAL ONLY.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects the read-only substitution and restores actual flash coverage and correct version evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its reflash/write-proof safeguards but changes classification to MANUAL ONLY for required EFI/BIOS-menu interaction.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates agent evidence from engineer observation and verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a non-write SMBIOS query from falsely satisfying a destructive reflash testcase and distinguishes write success from unchanged version identity.
independent_technical_reasoning: Reflash has the same bricking risk as other BIOS writes despite identical version. Its unique acceptance requires write proof plus BIOS Setup observation, so it remains MANUAL ONLY with substantial agent assistance.

source_provenance.history: review_round_02_functionality.md exact-code entry and repository exact-code search

no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat reflash, change regions/image, reboot after a write error or start recovery without a new engineer-directed plan.
